spine.active_goal: Bring the live Today page, Calendar, day modal and note view/edit modal to parity with the Claude Design mock-up: compact log cards with an in-place Edit/Delete pill, a view-only log modal unified with the editor, a contained day modal without yellow underlines, and pager navigation on the calendar. Specified through the interphase prototype pathway, then built through mitosis.
spine.next_step: The owner runs LANG=en_US.UTF-8 flutter run -d macos on main (local branch check/parity at 9567b61) and compares Today, a card's hover pill, view mode, edit mode, the day modal and the calendar with the design; their confirmation closes criterion 3. Scratch cleanup is done: the five scratch worktrees, the local mitosis/cards, modal, screens, calendar and cleanup branches and base/parity are deleted, and GitHub had already deleted the five merged remote branches.

open_risks.text: The existing day-modal tests mount DayDetailPanel under a Scaffold (test/features/day_detail/support/day_detail_harness.dart:16), which supplies a Material and hides the yellow-underline defect. An underline test that reuses that harness passes on broken code; the spec requires every underline check to open its surface through its real show function.

The manage pill rises 15 points above its card, and Flutter hit-tests children only inside the parent's box, so a naive Stack placement leaves the top 11 points of each 28 point button dead, under the 24 point floor. A tap at the button's centre still passes, so the spec's test taps 2 points below the button's top edge.

The live edit pipeline pops its route on save (day_detail_edit_note.dart:95) and on close (composer_guard.dart:70). Edit mode reached from view mode must run inside view mode's route and return to it instead, which is the hardest structural change in the log-viewer Step.

Every note's composer header changed in PR 165: a labelled Cancel or Back pill and a left-aligned title replace the bare close glyph shipped in phase 5, and saving an edit now asks Save changes first. Owner-approved, but it touches the surface the owner tuned most recently.

The compact card sizes a short note to 13.5pt by scaling the text scaler around NoteBody, because NoteBody takes no style parameter. It composes with the user's text scale, but it replaces a non-linear system scaler with a linear one inside that card.
